target.title: fix(msteams): add timeouts to SharePoint file send requests
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes MS Teams group/channel file sends that could hang indefinitely when SharePoint upload, sharing-link creation, chat-member lookup, drive-item metadata, or response-body reads stalled.

## Why This Change Was Made

The affected SharePoint/Graph calls now use an aborting timeout around the full fetch lifecycle, including response-body reads. Short Graph control-plane requests retain the existing 30 second MS Teams request timeout. SharePoint content PUTs use a 5 minute base stall bound plus a transfer budget at 256 KiB/s, matching the adjacent MS Teams file-consent upload policy.

The chat-member fallback is also fail-closed: only an explicit Graph HTTP 403 widens the link to organization scope. Timeouts, network failures, 5xx responses, token failures, and empty recipient sets propagate instead of broadening access.

## User Impact

MS Teams file sends no longer remain pending forever when Microsoft Graph or SharePoint stops responding. Slow valid large uploads get a transfer-sized deadline, while transient failures cannot silently widen link permissions.

## Evidence

Exact head: `a8e3b3ce9a6b9371bd5e839a542baba6638949c4`.

Focused local fallback validation:

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/msteams/src/graph-upload.test.ts extensions/msteams/src/request-timeout.test.ts
-> 2 files passed, 20 tests passed

git diff --check
-> clean
```

The focused suite covers:

- slow large upload success beyond the 5 minute base bound;
- abort at the size-aware transfer deadline;
- stalled response-body reads;
- 403-only organization-scope fallback;
- fail-closed timeout, 503, token-failure, and empty-recipient paths.

Controlled loopback transport proof used production `uploadAndShareSharePoint()` / `uploadToSharePoint()` helpers and real Node HTTP transport with Microsoft URLs redirected to a local server:

```text
slow-upload-success: elapsedMs=31068, result=success
createLink-control-plane-stall: TimeoutError after 30016ms, server socket closed after 30005ms
upload-transfer-stall: TimeoutError at the upload deadline, server socket closed at the deadline
```

This is controlled transport proof, not a live Microsoft tenant run; no tenant credentials were available.

Fresh pre-push autoreview on the current branch reported no accepted/actionable findings (`patch is correct`, confidence `0.92`). A separate exact-shape runtime probe confirmed that a late rejection from a losing `Promise.race` input does not emit `unhandledRejection` (`unhandled=0`).

GitHub exact-head CI is green, including `openclaw/ci-gate`, channel runtime boundary, lint, dependency, production types, test types, and Node compact shards.

Remote Testbox/Crabbox was unavailable in this environment, so validation used the narrow local fallback plus GitHub CI.
